adTextSnapshot: Free standard shipping on orders over $50. US only.
statedInterpretation: The ad says 'over $50'. The approved contract interprets the boundary as inclusive: an after-discount merchandise subtotal of exactly $50.00 qualifies. The ad wording is preserved here and is not silently rewritten.
